messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Added reduced motion rules in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:49) to disable card transitions and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:38) to disable the win banner pulse. The existing motion settings remain unchanged for users who haven’t enabled reduced motion.

I didn’t run tests.
